title: Hormuz Shutdown Rewrites the Board — TTF & JKM Set for Monster Gap Higher at Monday Open
edito: Hormuz rewrites everything: Iran's de facto closure of the world's most critical LNG chokepoint collides with EU storage at a historic 29.98% — the most acute gas risk environment since 2022. The council validated 13 of 21 trade ideas, culling 8 for duplicates, mispriced strikes, and internal contradictions. Duration of the Hormuz disruption is the single variable that separates a spike-and-fade from a regime change.

title: HH Crashes Through $3.00 to $2.92 — Storm Fern Rally Fully Erased; TTF Settles €30.90
edito: Winter's last gasp meets structural fragility: HH crashes through $3 as US supply overwhelms, but EU storage at decade-lows and a fractured sanctions regime set up a volatile refill season. The transatlantic divergence — US surplus vs EU deficit — is this week's defining tension, and the council validated 14 of 21 trade ideas after culling 7 for redundancy and contradiction.

title: HH Bounces Off 5-Month Low at $2.86 — TTF Holds €31.50 as Regas Margins Turn Positive
edito: The warm reprieve is a mirage. Storage at 30% with the Russian LNG ban activating in five weeks means the refill math is brutal — and a stratospheric vortex disruption could extend winter demand just as the market prices spring. Asymmetry favours upside protection.

title: HH Slides to $3.17 on Warmer Shift — TTF Drifts Lower to €31.25; NBP Mar Jumps 7%
edito: EU storage at historic lows meets record LNG arrivals and fracturing sanctions unity — the market is pricing a comfortable spring while sitting on the thinnest cushion since 2022. title: TTF Eases to €32 After Iran Whipsaw — HH Eyes Gap Higher on Bomb Cyclone
edito: Hormuz tensions collide with EU storage at historic lows — the gas market is caught between record LNG arrivals and a geopolitical tinderbox. The 30.8% storage level and Alpine hydro deficit make this week's data releases critical inflection points for Q2 positioning.

title: TTF Holds Above €31 as NBP Spikes on Front-Month Squeeze; HH Steady Post-Storm Normalisation
edito: TTF holds €31.55 as EU storage scrapes 30.9% — a 10pp YoY deficit and the lowest late-Feb reading since 2022. Record LNG arrivals (14.2 Mt) meet depleted Norwegian hydro, an April 25 Russian LNG ban, and Hormuz drills. EUA crashes 23% on Merz ETS bombshell. The refill math barely works — if it doesn't, Q3 reprices violently.

title: HH March Settles Below $3 as EIA Draw Fails to Inspire — TTF Holds €31.88
edito: HH breaks below $3 on a yawn-inducing EIA print while EU storage scrapes multi-year lows at 33%. The market is sleepwalking into refill season — record LNG arrivals mask a structural deficit that one March cold snap could expose. Watch the tails, not the base case.
